text: Professional Overview：The major of Landscape architecture mainly studies the basic knowledge and skills in landscape architecture planning, regional planning, botany, etc., and conducts the planning and construction of landscape architecture, as well as the protection and restoration of traditional gardens. It is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates architecture, urban planning, environmental art, municipal engineering design, zoology and botany, etc. Its aim is to design a beautiful outdoor living environment by comprehensively utilizing scientific and artistic means.Training Objectives：The training objectives of different schools may vary slightly, but generally speaking, they all aim to cultivate professional talents with solid foundations, broad knowledge, high professional qualities and strong practical abilities. For instance, Sichuan Agricultural University aims to cultivate advanced compound application-oriented talents who can be engaged in the planning and design, construction and management, teaching and research, protection and utilization of landscape architecture in design and construction units, educational and research institutions, management departments, etc.Main courses：Core courses: including History of Chinese and Foreign gardens, Landscape Architecture Planning and Design, Landscape Architecture Architectural Design, Plant Landscape Planning and Design, Landscape Architecture Engineering Management, Landscape Architecture Engineering, Green space Planning and Design for Residential Areas, Park Planning and Design, Protection and Design of Landscape Architecture Heritage, etc.Practical teaching: There are landscape architecture environmental cognition practice, classical garden research practice, landscape engineering technology practice week, construction site practice, color practice, historical building surveying practice, etc.
